phase1_requires: sealed real T-5 capture, before-post prediction and paper decision, actual result payout settlement; replay is never PASS
split: TEST year Y; CAL year Y-1; TRAIN through Y-2; expanding begins 2013; rolling begins max(2013,Y-6)
features: fixed safe46 excluding safe_past5_top3_rate plus identical 4 observed-market features; no outcome-driven feature changes
history: strict history_race_date < target_race_date; same-day outcomes excluded; immutable eligible raw cache, last date 20260913
gpu_policy: do not mix unverified custom-objective GPU execution with CPU comparison; GPU speedup is not claimed
race_nll: whole-race softmax(log(p_market)+residual), single-winner race NLL; gradient p-y, diagonal Hessian p*(1-p) floored at 1e-6, off-diagonal terms omitted
binary: runner-weighted binary residual with logit(p_market) offset then sigmoid and within-race normalization
calibration: CAL-only bounded market-conditioned log-linear softmax(a*log(p_original)+b*log(p_market)); a in [0.5,2], b in [-1,1], ridge 0.01*((a-1)^2+b^2)
rmse: winner-probability RMSE may be reported with its own label; physical speed RMSE is not available from these winner models
calibration_metrics: matched date-cluster bootstrap delta NLL and Brier
reference: normalized reciprocal final odds; fixed market-favorite singles
reference_scope: raw uncalibrated market diagnostic; four candidates share the same CAL procedure, but delta vs raw market alone is not proof of independent feature edge
uncertainty: paired whole dates stratified by year; ROI simultaneous Bonferroni 9-family; no-bet dates retained
candidate_comparison: 2016-2024 retrospective development and 2025-2026 previously-seen diagnostic periods reported separately; no new independent holdout claim
candidate_selection: no activation; retrospective probability-only ranking, not ROI maximization; all four retained
payout: actual saved netkeiba win return table joined by race and sole winner; unavailable payouts excluded only from ROI with reasons, never substituted with odds
odds_timing: historical final odds are a retrospective proxy, not verified executable pre-start quotes
